# Examples

```{=latex}
\clearpage
\newcounter{savepage}        % Create a temporary counter
\setcounter{savepage}{\value{page}} % Save the current page number
\pagenumbering{gobble} % Turns off page numbering
\pdfpagewidth=420mm    % Set PDF media width to A3
\pdfpageheight=297mm   % Set PDF media height to A3

\includepdf[
    pages=-, 
    fitpaper=true, 
    pagecommand={\thispagestyle{empty}} % Ensures no headers/footers/page numbers
]{examples/OLB_Examples.pdf}

\clearpage
\pagenumbering{arabic} % Restores page numbering for the following sections
\setcounter{page}{\value{savepage}} % Restores the saved number
\stepcounter{page}           % Increment by 1 so it continues correctly
\pdfpagewidth=210mm    % Restores A4 width
\pdfpageheight=297mm   % Restores A4 height
```
